/.title: Routini - Open-source AI engineer for jobs, fleet and incidents
/.description: Routini runs coding agents that open pull requests and SRE agents that triage alerts, on your servers or ours, and asks before it touches production.

/how-it-works.title: How Routini works - from model key to merged pull request
/how-it-works.description: Twelve steps from sign-up to running jobs: add a model key, connect servers, set guardrails, approve what matters and turn alerts into postmortems.

/pricing.title: Routini pricing - free to self-host, free hosted alpha
/pricing.description: Self-host Routini free under AGPL, or use the hosted alpha free with fair compute limits. Bring your own model keys; your own servers are never counted.

/privacy.title: Privacy policy - Routini
/privacy.description: What Routini stores about you and your org, why it keeps it, how long it keeps it, and how to export or delete it.

/terms.title: Terms of service - Routini
/terms.description: The terms for using hosted Routini at routini.tynhub.com during the alpha, including acceptable use and your responsibility for connected servers.

/login.title: Sign in - Routini
/login.description: Sign in to Routini to manage your jobs, fleet of servers, and coding and SRE agents from your console.

/signup.title: Create your account - Routini
/signup.description: Create a free Routini account to connect servers, add a model key, and start running jobs and coding agents.
